messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy started: tagged release v2026.03-hotfix-12 -> prod (eu-west-2). Commit a1b2c3d4. Initiated by Jess. Canary: 5% traffic for 10m. Release notes: fix tokenizer OOM; runtime kernel bump. <https://ci.redwood/release/v2026.03-hotfix-12/releases>
Jess: Canary window 10m, monitoring dashboards up. ping @Alejandra @Darren :rocket:
Alejandra: Watching error budget + latency dashboards :eyes:
deploy-bot: Canary update: healthchecks 3/3, 5% traffic, no increase in 4xx/5xx. Avg response 98ms. CI-smoke passed.
Sam (oncall): If anything spikes >2x p95, I'll flip rollback :thumbsup:
Jess: Promoting to 50% now.
deploy-bot: Promote phase started: 50% -> 100% in 2m steps. Current: 50%.
Alejandra: After 50% promote, p95 in eu-west rose from ~420ms to ~690ms. Request queue depth on inference nodes increased. No obvious 5xxs yet. Flagging this as performance regression :warning:
Darren: Do we have the previous quantized model pinned anywhere? We could pin model_variant=stable-q4 and re-promote as a mitigation.
Jess: Quick question — is rollback faster or is pin safer? We need the fastest way to restore SLOs.
Sam (oncall): Rollback is the fastest to restore baseline. Pin requires config rollout + model warmup and could take longer.
Alejandra: Agree with rollback for eu-west only. Previous tag v2026.03-hotfix-11 was stable there. Recommend targeted rollback.
deploy-bot: Suggested command: `deploy rollback --env prod-eu-west --to v2026.03-hotfix-11 --reason "p95 regression"`
Jess: Executing rollback to v2026.03-hotfix-11 for eu-west now.
deploy-bot: Rollback started: target v2026.03-hotfix-11 -> prod-eu-west. Initiated by Jess. Estimated 3m.
deploy-bot: Rollback success: 12/12 instances healthy, traffic rebalanced. All services back to v2026.03-hotfix-11. Healthchecks OK :white_check_mark:
Alejandra: Monitoring: p95 returned to ~430ms. No new errors observed. Keeping an eye for 10m.
Darren: Opening a postmortem ticket to investigate root cause. Assigning to infra + model-ops.
Jess: Thanks all. We'll re-run a pinned-variant canary next week (model_variant=stable-q4) before reintroducing the fix. Notifying product and support.
deploy-bot: Deployment thread closed. If you need to reopen, reply here.
